description: An Imperial cream linen court gown with a low square neckline, naturally fitted opaque bodice, elbow sleeves and floor-length skirt with a modest below-knee walking opening. Plum panels and rich gold woven borders decorate the neckline, waist, cuffs, front and hem. A plum shoulder wrap rests along the arms. Small gold clasps, a pendant necklace, earrings, bracelet and ring provide restrained high-noble ornament. Decorated flat gold shoes remain visible.
